name: get_design_pack
description: Get an authored Motif design pack for what you're building: a design brief (what to build and why), acceptance requirements (each marked deterministic, client_local_test or human_review), design tokens, a layout contract, interaction states and short excerpts from the relevant guides. Give a product_brief in plain words (e.g. 'task planner app with reminders', 'pricing page for a SaaS') and the platform; add workflow or project_id to sharpen the match, or pack_id (+ version) to pin one. Returns NO_MATCH rather than inventing advice. Free accounts get the free packs; Creator gets all. Counts one content operation; each premium guide excerpt counts once per billing month.
